result.title: QSRadar: Query-Conditioned Sparse Radar-Camera Fusion for Efficient 3D Object Detection
result.comment: Radar-camera fusion, 3D object detection, autonomous driving
result.summary: Reliable 3D object detection for autonomous trucks requires both the semantic detail provided by cameras and the geometric and motion cues measured by 4D radar. Existing radar-camera detectors commonly construct global radar bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations, whose computational and memory costs grow with the perception range. Sparse query-based detectors offer greater efficiency, but global feature construction can obscure point-level radar geometry and motion information. We present QSRadar, a query-conditioned sparse radar fusion framework for efficient long-range 3D detection. Built on a Sparse4Dv3-style visual-temporal detector, QSRadar retrieves a compact set of raw radar points around each evolving object hypothesis. The selected points are represented in an anchor-aligned coordinate frame, augmented with motion residuals, radar cross section, and sweep timing, and aggregated by a query-conditioned set encoder. Radar neighborhoods are retrieved again after each anchor refinement, coupling evidence selection with object estimation. Under the official MAN TruckScenes validation protocol, QSRadar achieves 38.09 mAP and 52.20 NDS, compared with 37.08 mAP and 50.78 NDS for our reproduced Sparse4D-Radar global Radar-BEV baseline. In matched tests on an RTX 4090 D, QSRadar reduces latency by 45%, peak memory usage by 49%, and GFLOPs by 43%.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 QSRadar，一个面向自动驾驶长程 3D 检测的 query 条件稀疏雷达-相机融合框架：围绕每个演化中的目标假设检索少量原始雷达点，在 anchor 对齐坐标系下编码并结合运动残差等属性，且在每次 anchor 精化后重新检索邻域，配合 Sparse4Dv3 式检测器实现更低延迟与显存。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按查询假设检索原始证据、随状态精化反复重取」的机制可供核查是否能迁移为 LVR 中的证据获取与 LOOK 时机决策，但领域为 3D 检测，与 VLM 推理状态的关系尚需判断。
